indication_area: Oncology (germline BRCA-mutated HER2-negative breast cancer; HRR gene-mutated mCRPC with Xtandi)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 211651 NDA APPROVAL ... for Talzenna (talazoparib) capsules, 0.25 mg and 1 mg ... for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline breast cancer susceptibility gene (BRCA)-mutated (gBRCAm) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (electronically signed 10/16/2018)

series_start_reason: Pfizer's quarterly earnings releases and periodic reports print no Talzenna row before the first-quarter 2024 release. The April 2024 'Recasted Product Revenue Tables' (investor-relations PDF) print Talzenna for each quarter of 2023 and 2022, so the contiguous series starts 2022Q1. The full-year figures printed in the 2025 Form 10-K (2024: 117, 2023: 64, 2022: 48) agree with the quarters within rounding. No document found prints 2018-2021 Talzenna revenue (approved October 2018); those years sit in 'All other Oncology' in the releases.
notes: Worldwide revenue line named for the brand in Pfizer's Oncology product table under the column groups WORLDWIDE | UNITED STATES | TOTAL INTERNATIONAL; the same table prints U.S. and International columns, both nonzero throughout, so the line is a company worldwide total for the brand (breast cancer and, from the June 2023 US approval, mCRPC with Xtandi as listed in the 10-Q of 2023-08-09). 2022 and 2023 quarters come from the recasted table, which states it conforms 2023 to the 2024 presentation (royalty income reclassified into revenues); the 2023 figures equal the prior-year columns printed in the 2024 quarterly releases (10, 12, 20, 22). From 2024Q1 each quarter is read from its own release.
search_log: Listed Pfizer (CIK 0000078003) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages), all forms incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-K, 10-Q; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2018-01 to 2026-08 (35 earnings releases read; the 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases) and read each EX-99.1; fetched every 10-Q/10-K filed 2019-02 to 2026-08 and scanned table rows for the product names.

Table rows were taken from the HTML <tr> rows of each exhibit; the quarter figure is the first occurrence of the product row (the quarter block under WORLDWIDE | UNITED STATES | TOTAL INTERNATIONAL); later occurrences are international sub-regions and year-to-date blocks.

Releases 2018-01 to 2023-10 and 10-Q/10-K rows 2019-2023 print no Talzenna revenue row (only pipeline and approval text); the first revenue row is 'Talzenna | 23 | 10' in the first-quarter 2024 release.

Found the investor-relations PDF 'Recasted 2023 Product Revenue Tables' (s206.q4cdn.com ... /2024/04/Recasted-2023-Product-Revenue-Tables.pdf): Talzenna 2023 and 2022 by quarter and full year (64 and 48); used for 2022Q1-2023Q4.

The investor-relations 'Historical Financials for Product Revenues' file dated 2021-10-21 is listed on investors.pfizer.com but the site returns HTTP 403 to automated requests and its URL could not be found by search; it was not read, so 2018-2021 quarters may exist there and were not checked.

Annual check: 2022 quarters 11+13+13+11 = 48 and 2023 quarters 10+12+20+22 = 64 equal the recast full-year columns; 2024 quarters 23+32+36+27 = 118 against 117 printed (rounding); 2025 quarters 40+46+47+49 = 182 equals the printed 182.
Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: none of the Pfizer documents read states a first-sale date.
